package.name: mower_cameras
package.description: OpenCV/V4L2 fallback camera driver for the Airseekers Tron. Both outputs are opt-in: enable_rear publishes the rear USB UVC camera (/dev/rear_camera, MJPEG 1920x1080) as /rear_camera/image_raw + camera_info (used when cameras.launch.py rear_driver:=opencv, because v4l2_camera cannot decode MJPEG); enable_stereo splits the Metoak side-by-side stereo into /vio/left/image_raw and /vio/right/image_raw (debug fallback for stereo_vio_bridge, never both).
